verdict.rationale: Aircall's homepage says calls, SMS and messaging live in one platform, and that a shared inbox keeps every conversation visible so the team can collaborate in real time and step in without losing context. Together these cover the core of texts reaching a team-visible shared inbox, but only as homepage marketing claims. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the inbox shows which agent replied to each text, documentation tying SMS on the business number specifically to the shared inbox, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
